atoms.a: What are the pink lines you see in this person’s body?

atoms.b: The peripheral nervous system makes up all the nerves that go to your ((++skin bed)), muscles and other organs.
This system carries ((++messages birds)) to and from the brain and spinal cord.

For example: if you accidentally touched a boiling pot of water, a message would ((++immediately very_slowly)) be sent to your central nervous system telling you to take your hand away as soon as possible!
We either actively or automatically do something. Taking your hand away when touching something hot is an ((++automatic active)) response.
An example of doing something ((++actively automatically)) would be playing an instrument.

instruction.text: Is the response automatic or active?

atoms.a: salivating to get ready to eat
